A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Fern forecasting study, with all 23 pages and Appendix A.1–A.6 available. Text, rendering and PDF-content comparisons establish identical research content; differences are confined to bibliographic metadata and the arXiv margin stamp.

before.justification: v5 reports original forecasting experiments on synthetic systems and ETT datasets, component ablations, and multi-horizon results in Tables 2–3 and 8–15.

after.justification: v6 retains those original forecasting experiments, ablations and multi-horizon results unchanged, including the appendix tables.

M1.justification: Section 2, Algorithm 1 and Appendix A.3.3 retain the same bidirectional encoder, patchwise SPD transport, Householder parameterization and model components. The training objective is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain identical synthetic forecasting and shock scenarios, ETT evaluations, and ETTh1/ETTh2/Weather zero-pattern analyses. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains TimeMixer, PatchTST, DLinear, Koopa, ModernTCN and PFNN. The detailed comparisons retain TimeMixer, PatchTST and DLinear, with identical comparator membership in corresponding experiments.

E3.justification: Appendix A.5 specifies identical shock and detailed-table protocols, including splits, preprocessing, learning rates, batch sizes, horizons and checkpoint grace periods. Evaluation metrics in Appendix A.1 are unchanged.

E4.justification: Tables 3 and 8 retain identical component ablations and reflection-count comparisons. Shock robustness tests, checkpoint and zero-pattern analyses, and spectral/error case studies are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions specify the same two seeds for shock experiments and four seeds for detailed experiments. Standard-error reporting in Table 9 and Tables 11–15 is identical.

E6.justification: All numerical result entries and plotted findings match. For example, Table 2 retains Fern's Rossler-Base and Rossler-Param MSEs of 0.019 and 0.036; appendix results in Tables 8–15 are also identical.

T1.justification: The Brenier-based transport formulation, Householder properties, metric definitions, complexity derivations and dynamical-system equations are identical. No mathematical assumption, derivation or proof changes.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain identical claims about local Jacobian modeling, efficient spectral transport, synthetic benchmarking and forecasting robustness. No contribution is added, strengthened or narrowed.

C2.justification: Interpretations of channel independence, benchmark artifacts, spectral diagnostics and operator-learning comparisons are unchanged. The same applicability qualifications remain, including deferral of full probabilistic evaluation to future work.

D1.justification: Architectural bounds, simulation instructions, hyperparameters, compute-footprint information and training-log disclosure are identical. The code-availability statement and repository link also remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 4, appendix positioning discussions and the complete reference list are identical. No cited work or substantive relationship to prior research changes.

P1.justification: The arXiv margin stamp changes from v5 dated 23 March 2026 to v6 dated 2 May 2026. PDF title metadata changes from 'FRIREN: Beyond Trajectories -- A Spectral Lens on Time' to 'Ellipsoidal Time Series Forecasting', matching the title already displayed in both PDFs. Body language and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–4, Tables 1–15, captions and page layout are identical. Pages 2–23 render pixel-identically; the only rendered difference on page 1 is the margin-stamp text, without a layout change.

improvement.justification: The research text, theory, experimental evidence, limitations and appendices are identical. Correcting the PDF title metadata and updating the arXiv stamp and version link provide bibliographic housekeeping without a meaningful change in the paper's overall quality.
